name: The Mid-Atlantic
seasonNote: Roll south out of New England into New York City for a multi-week stay, then work down through New York State, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Delaware, and Maryland as fall deepens, closing in Washington, DC before the trip turns toward the warmer South.
summary: The megalopolis and its hinterland: New York City, the Hudson Valley and the state capitals, the Jersey Shore, Philadelphia and the Pennsylvania Dutch country, Gettysburg, the du Pont estates and Delaware beaches, the Chesapeake at Baltimore and Annapolis, and the monuments of Washington, DC.
